architecture.lifetime: Detached mounts remain accessible through accepted OFDs. Future pathname calls observe the replacement. Cancellation uses original accepted request cleanup, no output effects or imposed independent CQ order.
architecture.policy: Existing read-only, mutation EPERM, directory cursor and preflight rules are preserved. No POSIX mq syscall implementation or extra guest policy is introduced.

regressions: Already captured source resolvers see new original mounts without owner refresh.

Accepted io_uring drain survives FD close/reuse and mount replacement; original completion vs new pathname; cancellation leaves output untouched and future requests remain usable.
Shared-mm four/twelve logical CPU and one-slot tests use finite calls then original infinite futex waits; no returned syscall, service request or mapping checkpoint.
